_comment: Elite tier (160+ km/wk band). Should carry the full apparatus: Summit Water Dump, weighted ME carries, 8-10g/kg race-day carb loading, the 30-40 min Zone 4 weekly cap, double-day 8-12h spacing, and the daily-repeatability readiness test. This is the tier the beginner/novice fixtures are checked against NOT leaking -- a regression that strips this content from elite would be as wrong as leaking it into beginner.
